Thirteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Sunday, October 25, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

RICHARDS, JEROMIE SCOTT

RICHARDS, JEROMIE SCOTT was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 12:14 a.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of theft of property valued at $100 or more but less than $750. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

LOPEZ, MELESIO JR

LOPEZ, MELESIO JR was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 4:02 a.m. on alleged charges of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor, and unlawful carrying of a weapon, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set on either charge; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

DIAZ, PAULINO, JR

DIAZ, PAULINO, JR was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 4:42 a.m. on an alleged Class A misdemeanor charge of resisting arrest, search or transport. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

GUZMAN-VEGA, DIEGO

GUZMAN-VEGA, DIEGO was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 5:02 a.m. on an alleged Class A misdemeanor charge of driving while intoxicated with a blood-alcohol concentration of 0.15 or more. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

CHAIRES, JOSE ALEJANDRO

CHAIRES, JOSE ALEJANDRO was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 6:35 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged Class A misdemeanor charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

MEZA, JULIAN

MEZA, JULIAN was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 7:18 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged Class A misdemeanor charge of assault causing bodily injury. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

AMADOR-MENDIOLA, FILIBERTO was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 10:57 a.m. on an alleged Class A misdemeanor charge of driving while intoxicated with a blood-alcohol concentration of 0.15 or more. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

FERNANDEZ, NANCY MICHELLE

FERNANDEZ, NANCY MICHELLE was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 12:21 p.m. on alleged charges of driving while intoxicated with a blood-alcohol concentration of 0.15 or more, a Class A misdemeanor, and accident involving damage to a vehicle of $200 or more, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set on either charge; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

OCHOA DE LA O, JOSE DANIEL was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 3:48 p.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of driving while intoxicated. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

GARZA, ARMANDO was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 4:52 p.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of criminal trespass. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

LEIJA, GRACIELA was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 7:12 p.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of driving with a license invalid with a previous conviction, suspension, or without financial responsibility. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the person is being held on an out-of-county hold.

FLORES, ARNULFO JOEL

FLORES, ARNULFO JOEL was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 8:13 p.m. on an alleged Class A misdemeanor charge of indecent assault. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the person is being held on an out-of-county/state hold.

CORDOVA, MELVIN OMAR

CORDOVA, MELVIN OMAR was arrested on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 10:34 p.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of accident involving damage to a vehicle of $200 or more. No bond amount was shown in the booking record summary available; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.
